correctness.rationale: The exact 9-symbol local map is checked. All pair factors of a one-step image lie in an enumerated set P of size 50. Exhaustion of every 7-symbol P-admissible word (589781 instances) proves that 3 additional steps yield only symbols 0,2,6; hence no excited sites after update four on ANY circumference, and all sites rest after update five. Independent direct graph-state enumeration for n=3..5 proves the sharp four-update exception. Two explicit seed families prove time-five survival for all n>=6 through finite dependence cones. Standalone ISO C++17 program reproduces every critical count.
